request.style: English, Afro-gospel, joyful male lead with choir, talking drums, congas, bright guitars, piano, bass, celebratory groove, 118 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
On the desert road to Gaza rolled a chariot in the sun
An official of the queen of Ethiopia, a long way he had come
He was reading from Isaiah, but he could not see the way
Then Philip ran up beside him and he heard the reader say

[Verse]
Like a sheep he was led to the slaughter
And like a lamb silent before its shearer
Do you understand what you are reading
How can I, unless someone guides me

[Chorus]
Look, here is water
What is to keep me from being baptized
Look, here is water
And he went on his way rejoicing

[Verse]
Philip began with that passage of Scripture
And told him the good news about Jesus
He ordered the chariot to stop
And both of them went down into the water

[Chorus]
Look, here is water
What is to keep me from being baptized
Look, here is water
And he went on his way rejoicing

[Outro]
He went on his way rejoicing
Rejoicing, rejoicing
